data.lede: Everything you need to know about working with NC Global Assets and entering the Thai market.

items.a: We focus exclusively on Thailand, with Bangkok as our primary operating base. From Bangkok, brands can build a foundation for a wider Southeast Asian expansion.
items.q: What markets do you focus on?

items.a: F&B is our strongest vertical, but we work with selected brands across lifestyle, sustainability, sport and digital platforms. The key criterion is whether your brand has a differentiated product and a real ambition to grow in Thailand.
items.q: Do you only work with F&B brands?

items.a: We work alongside brands as a local operating partner — not an external consultant. Agreements are structured as fixed models, performance-based fees, revenue share or equity participation depending on the project.
items.q: How does the partnership model work?

items.a: Absolutely. Market validation is one of the first phases we support. We run real sales pilots, gather customer feedback and validate product-market fit in Bangkok before scaling.
items.q: Can I test the market before fully committing?

items.a: A focused market test can be set up in 4–8 weeks using our existing infrastructure. A full market launch typically takes 3–6 months depending on the complexity of your product and model.
items.q: How long does it take to launch in Thailand?
